entities.summary: Fazalur Rehman was a Pakistani field hockey player. He competed in men's tournament at the 1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico and was part of team that won gold medal. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1972 Summer Olympics, where Pakistan won the silver medal.
